title: The Three Fishes
author: Ellen C. Babbitt
summary: 三条鱼中只有深思警觉危险，靠计谋救下另外两条。
publicDomainBasis: Retold by Ellen C. Babbitt and published in 1922 by The Century Co. (pre-1923, public domain in the United States); Project Gutenberg releases it as public domain.

paragraphs.en: Once upon a time three Fishes lived in a far-away river. They were named Thoughtful, Very-Thoughtful, and Thoughtless.
paragraphs.zh: 从前，有三条鱼住在一条遥远的河里。它们名叫多思、深思和少思。

paragraphs.en: One day they left the wild country where no men lived, and came down the river to live near a town.
paragraphs.zh: 有一天，它们离开没有人烟的荒野，顺流而下，来到一座城镇附近居住。

paragraphs.en: Very-Thoughtful said to the other two: "There is danger all about us here. Fishermen come to the river here to catch fish with all sorts of nets and lines. Let us go back again to the wild country where we used to live."
paragraphs.zh: 深思对另外两条鱼说：“这里到处都有危险。渔夫到河边来，用各种网和钓线捕鱼。我们还是回到从前住的荒野去吧。”

paragraphs.en: But the other two Fishes were so lazy and so greedy that they kept putting off their going from day to day.
paragraphs.zh: 可另外两条鱼又懒又贪，一天一天地拖延着不肯走。

paragraphs.en: But one day Thoughtful and Thoughtless went swimming on ahead of Very-Thoughtful and they did not see the fisherman's net and rushed into it. Very-Thoughtful saw them rush into the net.
paragraphs.zh: 有一天，多思和少思游到了深思前面，没看见渔夫的网，一头冲了进去。深思看见它们冲进了网里。

paragraphs.en: So swimming around the net, he splashed in the water in front of it, like a Fish that had broken through the net and gone up the river. Then he swam back of the net and splashed about there like a Fish that had broken through and gone down the river.
paragraphs.zh: 于是它绕着网游，在网前的水里扑腾，像一条冲破渔网、游向上游的鱼。接着它又游到网后，在那儿扑腾，像一条冲破渔网、游向下游的鱼。

paragraphs.en: The fisherman saw the splashing water and thought the Fishes had broken through the net and that one had gone up the river, the other down, so he pulled in the net by one corner. That let the two Fishes out of the net and away they went to find Very-Thoughtful.
paragraphs.zh: 渔夫看见水花，以为鱼已经冲破网，一条往上游去了，一条往下游去了，便从网的一角收网。这一收，两条鱼就脱离了网，赶紧游去找深思。

paragraphs.en: "You saved our lives, Very-Thoughtful," they said, "and now we are willing to go back to the wild country."
paragraphs.zh: “深思，你救了我们的命，”它们说，“现在我们愿意回到荒野去了。”

paragraphs.en: So back they all went to their old home where they lived safely ever after.
paragraphs.zh: 于是它们一起回到了老家，从此平平安安地生活着。
